name: Rechte
description: Rights table: per channel and tool allow, ask or off. Switch with /rights (alias /rechte).

language.description: Language of the visible texts (table, buttons, messages). Commands and level names are accepted in both languages regardless.

schutz.description: Protected paths for write/edit/apply_patch (relative to the agent workspace or absolute; a folder protects everything in it). "aus": never, "nachfragen": ask first. Applies before the table.
